ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 3
   C. 6
   D. 9

2. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 2

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 22
   C. 32
   D. 16

4. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 20

5. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 1

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

13. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

17. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 40.5
   D. 10

18. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

21. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

22. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

23. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 20
   D. 75

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
